name: obscura-browse
description: Browse a URL with the Obscura headless browser (Rust, V8, anti-detect) driven by Playwright over CDP. Returns page content as a JSON object — markdown, text, HTML, links, evaluated JS, or a screenshot. Auto-starts 'obscura serve' when the CDP endpoint is not reachable.
use_when: fetching JS-rendered or bot-protected web pages when web-fetch is not enough

args.name: --links
args.description: Include all anchor links in output.

args.name: --eval
args.description: JS expression evaluated in the page; result returned as 'result'.

args.name: --selector
args.description: Wait for CSS selector; scopes text/html extraction to it.

args.name: --screenshot
args.description: Save full-page PNG screenshot to path.

args.name: --no-stealth
args.description: Disable stealth mode when starting the server (default: on if the installed binary supports it).

args.name: --no-server
args.description: Fail instead of auto-starting obscura serve.

env.OBSCURA_BIN: Path to obscura binary. Default: vendor/obscura/obscura, else PATH

stdout: JSON object: {url, title, format?, content?|result?, links?, screenshot?}
notes: Obscura blocks private/loopback/LAN URLs by default; the tool passes --allow-private-network to the server it starts when the URL is private. A pre-existing server without that flag will still refuse private URLs.
